name: OpenFunction Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source Kubernetes Function-as-a-Service platform for synchronous and asynchronous functions, OCI image builds and event-driven scale-to-zero, with no software subscription or invocation quota.
watch_out: Requires self-managed Kubernetes and supporting build, event and runtime components (including dependencies such as Dapr); compute, networking, registries and third-party event sources may cost extra. CNCF Sandbox project; no managed free cloud hosting is included.
